status: Candidate 11 RPM passed 12 packaging regressions, 101 upstream tests (one upstream skip), native helper controls and all three 100-RPC injection runs. Nine installed Valgrind controls complete. Remaining unrelated compiler diagnostics are reviewed separately.
root_cause: The async completion queue pushes a Core completion and ignores the notification write result. EINTR can lose the wakeup; an unavailable wakeup descriptor leaves queued callbacks undelivered.
change: Retry EINTR/WSAEINTR and return whether one notification byte was written. If notification is unavailable, drain the queue and schedule callbacks via the bound event loops thread-safe API, without trying to read a nonexistent notification.

tests.native_baseline: Original helper loses the wakeup on the first injected EINTR; control fails its exact byte-delivery assertion.
tests.baseline_integration: Actual installed candidate 9 extension strands an async RPC when notification writes return EBADF. Two writes/failures are captured; timeout control exits 42 as expected.

upstream_context: The current upstream helper discards the write result through a variable; that removes a compiler warning but does not handle the failed notification. This patch addresses event delivery instead.
